0022600151.text: The Milwaukee Bucks, who are 1-4 and have lost their last game, host the Cleveland Cavaliers, who are 3-1 and riding a three-game winning streak. Milwaukee is 1-2 at home and 0-2 on the road, sitting 5th in the Central and 14th in the East, while Cleveland is 2nd in the Central, half a game back, and 5th in the East. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Bucks lost the season series 1-3, including a 123-116 defeat in Milwaukee on March 17, 2026.
